purpose: Take an existing working user interface and transform it into a distinctive, production-grade experience by researching current best-in-class interfaces in the exact niche, deriving product-specific visual directions, checking portfolio similarity, preserving approved functionality, and proving quality with independent evidence.

capabilities.name: Niche Visual Benchmark Scout
capabilities.responsibility: Search the current public web for strong direct-niche and adjacent interfaces and convert evidence into bounded non-copying criteria across typography, palette, layout, density, geometry, components, interaction, data presentation, imagery/iconography, mobile behavior and distinctiveness.

capabilities.name: Product Personality Analyst
capabilities.responsibility: Define audience expectations, emotional register, brand posture, information density, accessibility constraints and visual anti-goals before art-direction choices are made.

capabilities.name: Product UX Architect
capabilities.responsibility: Audit information architecture, task flows, navigation, hierarchy, friction, cognitive load and user journey without altering approved business scope.

capabilities.name: Art Director
capabilities.responsibility: Produce at least three genuinely divergent visual systems before selecting one; each direction must explicitly vary typography, palette, geometry, density, layout, component grammar, imagery, motion and data-viz language.

capabilities.name: Portfolio Visual Genome Auditor
capabilities.responsibility: Persist fingerprints of completed Run 015 outputs and detect unexplained visual convergence between proposed directions and unrelated Factory products.

capabilities.name: Design System Specialist
capabilities.responsibility: Create or normalize product-specific reusable tokens and component rules for typography, spacing, surfaces, controls, states, icons and responsive behavior without importing a default Run 015 house style.

capabilities.name: Interaction Designer
capabilities.responsibility: Specify feedback, transitions, motion, hover/focus/pressed behavior, loading, empty, success and error states with restraint and accessibility.

capabilities.name: Frontend Polish Engineer
capabilities.responsibility: Implement the approved visual and interaction changes in the existing frontend while preserving behavior, routes, data contracts and testable functionality.

capabilities.name: Responsive & Accessibility Specialist
capabilities.responsibility: Validate mobile, tablet and desktop layouts, touch targets, keyboard behavior, focus, contrast, readable type, reduced motion and accessible semantics.

capabilities.name: Visual Acceptance Scorer
capabilities.responsibility: Produce the structured UIX-100 scorecard plus niche-appropriateness and portfolio-distinction calibration for independent QA; cannot approve its own implementation work.

capabilities.name: Independent Visual Quality Auditor
capabilities.responsibility: Verify benchmark quality, art-direction divergence, portfolio similarity, functional preservation, viewport/accessibility evidence, score calculation and terminal eligibility independently of implementation.

allowedActions: produce screenshots, genome reports and scorecards

reuseEvidence: Run 015 already owns benchmarking, art direction, frontend polish and independent visual QA.
The new capability is an extension of the existing benchmark and art-direction loop, not a separate team.
Existing functional-equivalence, independent-QA and repair-regression safeguards remain in force.
a0Decision.residualUnownedLoop: Mandatory current niche-web benchmarking, explicit typography inspection, three divergent visual genomes, durable portfolio memory and fail-closed cross-product similarity review are missing from the current Run 015 loop.
